title: Rain Barrel Cover 200 L in Black 210D – Pulls Over the Barrel
seo_title: Rain Barrel Cover 200 L – Black 210D Fabric
seo_description: Cover for a 200 L rain barrel in black 210D fabric with a drawstring along the bottom edge. Keeps leaves, pollen and mosquito larvae out of the water.
descriptionHtml:
A green film is on the water by midsummer

Leaves and pollen drift down into the open barrel all spring, and mosquito larvae find their way in as soon as the water stands still. By midsummer a green, algae-covered film has already settled over the surface – and the barrel you meant to water with is full of something other than clean water.

A cover that pulls over the barrel from above – 200 L

The cover in black 210D fabric is pulled over the rain barrel from above and fits barrels of 200 liters. The drawstring along the bottom edge is tightened around the rim of the barrel so the cover stays in place.

Features

  • Fits 200 L rain barrels – the cover's dimensions are set to that size
  • Leaves, pollen and mosquito larvae are kept out of the water – the cover is pulled over the barrel from above
  • Stays put around the rim of the barrel – the drawstring along the bottom edge is tightened
  • Discreet black color – the cover is woven from 210D fabric

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The rain barrel is not included, only the cover.
